about: Six Bits: a terminal short on Shannon and the six lines, about 60 s. The user, 2026-09-30: 'shannon information theory does have relation to the i-ching, in the sense that the bits contain information and the 6 bits describe things with max entropy/efficiency', then 'yes please write up the shannon short' and 'spec looks good'. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-shannon-six-bits-design.md. Copy: Astra's revision adopted as is, round 1 (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-shannon-short.md), with the odds heading YARROW: STANDARD ODDS.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 90 bpm, G major, from 0 s as on 24 (Return); apart from the lessons' The Mountain

caption: Six lines, each yin or yang: six bits, 64 patterns. Claude Shannon measured information in bits in 1948. Photo: Tekniska museet, CC BY 2.0.

pages.a:
THE I-CHING IS A CHINESE BOOK.
BROKEN IS YIN. SOLID IS YANG.
EACH LINE FITS IN ONE BIT.

2 X 2 X 2 X 2 X 2 X 2 = 64.
SIX BITS IDENTIFY
ONE OF 64 PATTERNS.

WHEN ALL 64 PATTERNS
ARE EQUALLY LIKELY.

THREE FAIR COINS: YES.
YARROW STALKS: YES,
USING THE STANDARD ODDS.
EACH LINE CHOSEN INDEPENDENTLY.

WE DON'T KNOW.
THE LINK HERE IS MATHEMATICAL.

pages.q: WHAT DO SIX BITS TELL ME
pages.a:
WHICH PATTERN YOU HAVE.
THE BOOK ASKS HOW TO ACT.
YOU STILL HAVE TO JUDGE.
